items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 18:1
items.html: Its extension from below upward is called the Guf of Abba, which emerged through phase three of clothing and phase two of coarseness, whose level reaches Hochma. And the Guf of this level expanded into the reign of King Hesed. It is the aspect of Haya of ZA. (p. 520, Items 42, 43)
